recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中除成熟中顆粒球外，右下可見一顆帶細胞質泡狀突起的小型異常巨核細胞，周圍有數顆高核質比芽細胞與血小板團塊；小而異常的巨核系細胞配上 blebs，是 ML-DS 的線索。
features: Small atypical megakaryocyte (lower right) with a hypolobated nucleus and cytoplasm with peripheral blebs
Scattered blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm
Platelet clumps and large platelet/cytoplasmic fragments in the background
Preserved granulocytic maturation with numerous band and segmented neutrophils
Crenated red cells, consistent with smear artifact
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows preserved granulocytic maturation with numerous bands and segmented neutrophils, admixed with scattered blasts that have a high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm. A small atypical megakaryocyte with a hypolobated nucleus and blebbed cytoplasm is present at the lower right, and platelet clumps are seen in the background. Red cells show crenation artifact. In a patient with Down syndrome and 11% blasts, findings are consistent with myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome.

ddx.vs: Morphologically identical megakaryoblasts, but TAM occurs in the neonatal period and typically regresses, whereas ML-DS arises later (usually under 4 years).
Reactive marrow lacks increased blasts and atypical hypolobated megakaryocytes with blebbed cytoplasm.
Outside Down syndrome, dysplasia would be multilineage without the megakaryoblastic bias and GATA1 mutation.
